quality.explanation: Extreme negative sentinel-like heights survive the declared mask; average resampling may propagate unmasked sentinel values. Do not treat these as real elevation or repair with zero.

terrain.download_method: Range-capable COG; only requested study window and overviews read. Whole-file size is not the downloaded byte count.
limitations: Original1m dataset reduced to25m using GDAL average and available overviews. This is not an exact native-pixel arithmetic-average guarantee.
Band metadata says nodata255, but the derived subset contains extreme negative sentinel-like heights. No inferred replacement mask or zero filling applied.
Survey collection predates September2021 according to producer bulletin; later publication is not available-at-event terrain information.
Do not retroactively assign this epoch to the previously downloaded anonymous-edition IGN WCS grid.
